summary.t: Personalised Initial in Pine Wood and name in gold acrylic

text.t:
A delicate and unique piece, created in plywood painted in the colour chosen by you, featuring a prominent initial and a personalised name glued to the centre, also with a careful finish.
Designed to match every style and preference, this creation is perfect for decorating children's rooms, personalising spaces, or giving a special keepsake, made to measure for whoever receives it.
